mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a slowdown in economic activity, which leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong economic demand, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where both HOUST > 1,000 and PAYEMS > 135,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure, which leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS decreases > 50k.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 decreases > 1%.
